pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown regions exhibit polygonal geometry with relatively sharp edge gradients. Shapes transition from elongated, sub-rectangular forms on the upper neck to larger, irregular pentagonal and hexagonal tiles on the mid-flank, and smaller, more fragmented clusters toward the posterior.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream-toned interstitial pathways form a continuous, connected topological graph. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial. The pixel thickness of these corridors is relatively uniform across the central flank but exhibits increased narrowing in the regions of smaller patch fragmentation near the rump.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged 1D silhouette along the upper neck ridge, characterized by short, dark, vertically-oriented pixel clusters.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, dark avian-shaped pixel cluster (oxpecker) perched on the upper posterior dorsal ridge near the rump.
